Geml is the slow dating app for singles over 30 who are done with swiping and ready for a real relationship.

ONE MATCH AT A TIME
Forget the overwhelm. Geml delivers one compatible match each night — curated by an algorithm built for serious relationships, not endless options.

VIDEO DATES BUILT IN
Skip the texting limbo. Every match includes a video date within 48 hours, so you can feel real chemistry before meeting in person.

CONVERSATION INSIGHTS
Get feedback after every date. See your speaking balance, conversation flow, and areas to improve — like a dating coach without the price tag.

DESIGNED FOR RELATIONSHIP-READY SINGLES
Geml is built for professionals, divorcees, and intentional daters over 30 who value emotional intelligence over superficial swiping.

- No swiping — curated nightly matches
- In-app video dating
- Post-date analytics and insights
- Match Summary Reports to track your growth
- Fair algorithm — no pay-to-win mechanics

WHY SLOW DATING WORKS
Research shows choice overload kills connection. By focusing on one match at a time, Geml helps you invest attention where it matters.

We don't profit from keeping you single. We succeed when you find your person.

Download Geml. Your next first date is waiting.

android.desc:
Ready for a dating app that actually wants you to succeed?
Geml is the dating app built for relationship-ready singles who value quality over quantity. Instead of endless swiping, we give you one thoughtful match at a time—so you can focus on what matters: building a real connection.
How Geml works:
One match at a time
No more juggling conversations or wondering who to prioritize. We match you with one compatible person, giving both of you the space to truly get to know each other.
Video dates from anywhere
Skip the awkward texting phase. Our in-app video chat lets you have a real conversation from the comfort of home—perfect for busy professionals and parents alike.
Feedback that helps you grow
After each date, receive personalized insights about your conversation. Understand your strengths, discover areas to improve, and watch yourself become a better dater with every connection.
Why singles choose Geml:
• Matches based on compatibility, not just photos
• Intentional pacing that respects your time
• A community of serious, relationship-focused singles
• Tools to help you learn and grow through dating
Who is Geml for?
Geml is designed for singles over 30 who are done with superficial dating apps. Whether you're a busy professional, a single parent, or simply someone who believes in meaningful connections, Geml helps you date with intention.
Dating shouldn't feel like a second job. It should feel like growth, possibility, and maybe even a little excitement.
Download Geml and start your journey toward something real.

quotes.text:
I've been working on my attempt to build a dating app that isn't evil and actually helps. It feels like my graduate project after 46 first dates on my way to getting married this summer.

The basic idea is daters "teach" an algorithm what they like and then the algorithm uses the collective set of preferences to match everybody (or as many as possible) for single in-app "get to know you" chats. Everything is one-on-one to avoid overload and dead-end chats.

I now have working versions in the app stores and I'm currently testing in Seattle.
